title: Iran Squad Arrives in Tijuana, Mexico — 4 Days Before World Cup Opener; IRGC-Linked Officials Remain in Iran; Federation Still Protesting Denial of 14 Staff
detail: Iran's World Cup delegation arrived in Tijuana, Mexico on the morning of June 7 after departing Antalya, Turkey at 6:30 PM local time on June 6 and making a brief stopover in Spain. The squad is now established at their pre-confirmed base camp at Centro Xoloitzcuintle in Tijuana — 4 days before Iran's Group G opener vs New Zealand on June 15 at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California. While the players themselves hold approved US visas following White House confirmation on June 6, Iran's Football Federation continues to protest the denial of visas to 14 backroom officials and staff — including secretary-general Hedayat Mombeini and vice president Mehdi Mohammad Nabi. The US Ambassador to Turkey, Tom Barrack, had stated the embassy processed the visa applications; Iran's embassy in Turkey disputed aspects of the characterization publicly. Iran's operational capacity is materially reduced by the absent officials, though the squad will proceed to compete. US Secretary of State Rubio had explicitly separated athletes from IRGC-linked support staff in his public statements. Iran will commute from their Tijuana base across the US border by road for their Group G US matches. The diplomatic standoff — the first World Cup in history where a host country (the USA) is in active military conflict with a participating nation (Iran) — now enters its competition phase with 4 days to the June 11 kickoff at Estadio Azteca.

media.caption: Iran squad arrives in Tijuana — established at Centro Xoloitzcuintle base camp; 4 days to Group G opener vs New Zealand at SoFi Stadium

title: Messi Sits Out Argentina vs Honduras Friendly With Hamstring Concern — Trains Individually in Kansas City; Scaloni Expects Fit for June 16 Opener
detail: Lionel Messi sat out Argentina's pre-tournament friendly against Honduras on June 7, training separately on an individual programme in Kansas City while the squad played the warm-up match. Scaloni confirmed the absence is precautionary — Messi has been managing a 'muscular overload' in his left hamstring since Inter Miami's final MLS match in late May. The coach expressed confidence that Messi will be fit for Argentina's Group J opener vs Algeria on June 16 at Arrowhead Stadium, Kansas City. Messi's status for the final pre-tournament friendly vs Iceland on June 9 is doubtful. The decision to rest Messi is consistent with Argentina's careful management of the 38-year-old star, who was officially confirmed in the 26-man World Cup squad on May 30 by coach Scaloni. Messi is competing at a record-equalling sixth World Cup alongside Cristiano Ronaldo's record. Separately, the already-confirmed absence of defender Leonardo Balerdi (soleus injury, ruled out June 6) and goalkeeper Emiliano Martínez's fractured finger add to Argentina's medical concerns ahead of their title defense. Despite the injuries, Argentina remain among the tournament favorites as defending champions. 4 days to World Cup kickoff at Estadio Azteca.

media.caption: Messi sits out Argentina vs Honduras friendly June 7 — hamstring management; Scaloni expects him fit for June 16 Group J opener vs Algeria

title: Scotland 4-0 Bolivia; Brazil 2-1 Egypt (Neymar Absent, Trains Separately) — Final Pre-Tournament Friendlies June 7
detail: Scotland routed Bolivia 4-0 in their final pre-tournament friendly in New Jersey on June 7 — a commanding result as Steve Clarke's side prepares for their first World Cup since France 1998, entering Group C vs Haiti (June 14, Foxborough), Morocco (June 20), and Brazil (June 25). The margin of victory will boost confidence in an Andrew Robertson-captained side that includes Scott McTominay (Napoli) and John McGinn (Aston Villa). Brazil defeated Egypt 2-1 in their final pre-tournament warm-up, but the match was overshadowed by the absence of Neymar — who trained separately at Brazil's New Jersey base while the squad traveled to Cleveland for the friendly. Neymar is managing a Grade 2 calf strain suffered on May 17 vs Coritiba. Carlo Ancelotti confirmed an MRI is scheduled for Monday June 8 to assess the injury. Ancelotti acknowledged Neymar is doubtful for Brazil's June 13 Group D opener vs Morocco. FIFA rules allow squad replacements up to 24 hours before a team's first match, leaving Ancelotti's medical team a narrow window to determine whether Neymar requires replacement. Brazil remain strong Group D favorites regardless, with Vinicius Junior, Endrick, Matheus Cunha, and Bruno Guimaraes in the squad. 4 days to World Cup kickoff at Estadio Azteca.

media.caption: Brazil 2-1 Egypt as Neymar trains separately — Scotland 4-0 Bolivia. Neymar MRI Monday, doubtful for June 13 opener vs Morocco

title: Canada Confirms Maxime Crépeau as Starting GK; FIFA Cancels ~60 Free Tickets Issued by System Glitch — Attorneys General Probe Ongoing
detail: Two off-field developments on June 7 highlighted organizational and administrative dimensions of the 2026 World Cup. Canada head coach Jesse Marsch confirmed that Maxime Crépeau will be Canada's starting goalkeeper, edging out rival Dayne St. Clair in what Marsch described as 'the hardest decision of my coaching career.' Crépeau will start for the co-host nation as Canada begin Group B vs Qatar (June 13, Toronto), Switzerland (June 18), and Czech Republic (June 24). The decision settles one of Canada's most-debated squad questions. Separately, FIFA cancelled approximately 60 tickets that had been purchased at $0 due to a payment system glitch in the checkout flow on May 21 for group-stage matches in Toronto. FIFA sent emails to affected fans around June 4, giving them 7 days to pay full price or lose their seats. The incident drew sharp criticism given FIFA's record $10.9 billion revenue projections and dynamic pricing system that pushed final prices to $143,750 per seat on FIFA's own resale platform. The New York and New Jersey Attorneys General were already investigating FIFA's ticketing program for possible consumer protection violations; the glitch added a new dimension to that inquiry. 4 days to World Cup kickoff at Estadio Azteca.

media.caption: FIFA cancels ~60 free tickets issued by checkout system glitch — Canada confirms Crépeau as starting GK; NY/NJ AG probe ongoing
